display_name: 盲信道估计与条件信号先验源域原型
description: 从接收 IQ 用卷积网络估计有效复信道与噪声，用训练源IQ拟合的条件先验计算后验 IQ；已知真实信道仅作为源域诊断对照。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 GPU0; CPU 2 threads; fixed source model and F with TF32 disabled; real 48 source smoke and zero-gradient required

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ float32 [2,256]; per-training-example source simulation action and noise labels only; inference receives IQ, no simulator metadata
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: No TX labels, U_s truth, V or test read; source simulation action and noise labels supervise blind network; clean F pseudo labels fit prior.
data.validation_ref: 384 RX8 day3 source heldout IDs, 64 per impaired scene, previously seen in other source views; no checkpoint selection

permissions.query_use: Source-only pilot with RX8 source holdout; no target IQ, V, or truth
permissions.claim_scope: Single seed source-only diagnostic; no independent blind or real satellite claim

checkpoint.initialization: Random blind estimator, learned from simulator action/noise on 8192 source training records; disjoint 8192 source records fit frozen F pseudo-class priors; DURA loaded after estimator training for comparator only.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Pinned conditional Gaussian source release dff683121e48ba8ab4ae7619ea895dad690bd77c and known-action operator f443942e33318b9f72733908dc2735203addaa96 SHA-256 e01efc635b4bbdc17d41014d72c9e6bbe3ad631553da9c3cdb6489a3058f1427
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch3; evaluate 384 source holdout records without checkpoint selection; known-action variants are diagnostic-only.

execution.gpu_policy: physical GPU0 only, TF32 disabled; independently check availability, preserve others

metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Blind variants use received IQ only; known-action variants oracle; pseudo targets not true accuracy. No Phase1 test.

rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes
rows.budget_ref: 8192 train IDs, disjoint 8192 prior IDs, 3 epochs batch64; 384 RX8 source holdout
